items.verification: GET / and GET /conversations route to conversations#index; app/controllers/conversations_controller.rb:6 still loads Conversation.all and app/views/conversations/index.html.erb:8-10 renders the unscoped collection through the metadata/link partial.
The anonymous nav branch at app/views/layouts/application.html.erb:30-32 still contains only Sign up; GET /login remains routed at config/routes.rb:8-9.

The Rails-8.1-compatible vulnerable equivalent nokogiri 1.15.7 remains pinned in Gemfile:22 and the lockfile. Preserved sprint-03 bundle-audit output reports High CVE-2026-79770 and High GHSA-mrxw-mxhj-p664; bundle check passes.

GET /admin/users routes to admin/users#index. app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:7 interpolates params[:q] directly into a LIKE SQL string; a quote/OR/comment payload alters the predicate. Brakeman reports a High-confidence SQL Injection warning on line 7.

PATCH /admin/users/:id/deactivate(.:format) is routed. app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:3 skips require_admin! for JSON deactivation, and lines 36-42 find and destroy the target. A logged-in non-admin therefore has a live destructive path; ordinary HTML tests remain green.

test/controllers/admin/users_controller_test.rb:94-96 replaces the non-admin promotion security test with assert true. app/controllers/application_controller.rb:25-28 returns before role authorization for admin/users#promote, whose routed action updates the target role at app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:14-20.

verification.method: static inspection plus one bounded test-environment check
verification.routes: admin index, promote, and deactivate routes resolve statically
